translations.idiomatic: The usher entered to report; the host went out to receive the guest east of the main gate, faced west, and performed two bows; the guest returned the bows.

sentences.zh: 主者揖贊冠者，贊冠者報揖。

translations.literal: The host bowed with clasped hands to the crown announcer; the crown announcer returned the bow.
translations.idiomatic: The host bowed with clasped hands to the crown announcer, who returned the bow.

sentences.zh: 又揖賓，賓報揖。

translations.literal: Again he bowed to the guest; the guest returned the bow.
translations.idiomatic: He then bowed to the guest, who returned the bow.

sentences.zh: 主者入，賓贊次入，及內門至階。

translations.literal: The host entered; guest and announcer entered in order, reaching the inner gate to the steps.
translations.idiomatic: The host entered; the guest and announcer followed in order, proceeding to the inner gate and the steps.

sentences.zh: 主者請升，賓三辭，乃升。

translations.literal: The host requested ascent; the guest declined three times, then ascended.
translations.idiomatic: The host invited him to ascend; the guest declined three times, then ascended.

sentences.zh: 主者自阼階，立於席東，西向；

translations.literal: The host by the eastern steps stood east of the mat, facing west;
translations.idiomatic: The host ascended the eastern steps and stood east of the mat, facing west;

sentences.zh: 賓自西階，立於席西，東向。

translations.literal: the guest by the western steps stood west of the mat, facing east.
translations.idiomatic: the guest ascended the western steps and stood west of the mat, facing east.

sentences.zh: 賓贊冠者及庭，盥於洗，升自西階，入於東房，立於主贊冠者之南，西面。

translations.literal: The guest's crown announcer reached the courtyard, washed at the ablution place, ascended by the western steps, entered the eastern side room, stood south of the host's crown announcer, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The guest's crown announcer entered the courtyard, washed at the ablution place, ascended the western steps, entered the eastern side room, and stood south of the host's crown announcer, facing west.

sentences.zh: 主贊冠者導冠者立於房外之西，南面。

translations.literal: The host's crown announcer led the crown-wearer to stand west outside the room, facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The host's crown announcer led the crown-wearer to stand west of the room's exterior, facing south.

sentences.zh: 賓贊冠者取纚櫛簪，跪奠於筵南端，退立於席北，少東，西面。

translations.literal: The guest's crown announcer took the binding cord, comb, and hairpin, knelt and set them at the south end of the ceremonial mat, withdrew and stood north of the seat mat, slightly east, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The guest's crown announcer took the binding cord, comb, and hairpin, knelt and placed them at the south end of the ceremonial mat, then withdrew to stand north of the seat mat, slightly to the east, facing west.

sentences.zh: 賓揖冠者，冠者進升席，西向坐。

translations.literal: The guest bowed with clasped hands to the crown-wearer; the crown-wearer advanced and ascended the seat mat, sitting facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The guest bowed with clasped hands to the crown-wearer, who advanced, ascended the seat mat, and sat facing west.

sentences.zh: 賓贊冠者進筵前，東西跪，脫雙童髻，櫛畢，設纚，興，復位立。

translations.literal: The guest's crown announcer went before the ceremonial mat, knelt east and west, removed the double child topknots, finished combing, set the binding cord, rose, and returned to stand in position.
translations.idiomatic: The guest's crown announcer went before the ceremonial mat and knelt facing east and west, removed the double child topknots, finished combing, set the binding cord, rose, and returned to his standing position.

sentences.zh: 賓降至罍，洗盥訖，詣西階。

translations.literal: The guest descended to the water jar, finished washing at the ablution place, and went to the western steps.
translations.idiomatic: The guest descended to the water jar, finished washing at the ablution place, and proceeded to the western steps.

sentences.zh: 主者立於席後西面，賓立於西階上，東面。

translations.literal: The host stood behind the seat mat facing west; the guest stood atop the western steps facing east.
translations.idiomatic: The host stood behind the seat mat facing west, while the guest stood atop the western steps facing east.

sentences.zh: 執緇布冠者升，賓降一等受之，右執項，左執前，進冠者筵前，東向立。

translations.literal: The bearer of the black cloth cap ascended; the guest descended one step and received it, grasping the nape with the right hand and the front with the left, advanced to before the crown-wearer's ceremonial mat, and stood facing east.
translations.idiomatic: The bearer of the black cloth cap ascended; the guest descended one step to receive it, holding the nape with his right hand and the front with his left, then advanced to before the crown-wearer's ceremonial mat and stood facing east.

sentences.zh: 祝用士禮祝詞，祝畢，跪冠。

translations.literal: He intoned the prayer using the scholar's rite wording; when the prayer was finished, knelt and capped him.
translations.idiomatic: He intoned the prayer using the scholar's rite wording; when the prayer was finished, he knelt and placed the cap upon him.

sentences.zh: 興，復位。

translations.literal: Rose, returned to position.
translations.idiomatic: He rose and returned to his position.

sentences.zh: 賓贊冠者進筵前，東面跪，結纓，興，復位。

translations.literal: The guest's crown announcer went before the ceremonial mat, knelt facing east, tied the cap tassels, rose, and returned to position.
translations.idiomatic: The guest's crown announcer went before the ceremonial mat, knelt facing east, tied the cap tassels, rose, and returned to his position.

sentences.zh: 冠者興，賓揖之適房，賓主皆坐。

translations.literal: The crown-wearer rose; the guest bowed with clasped hands and directed him to the side room; guest and host both sat.
translations.idiomatic: The crown-wearer rose; the guest bowed with clasped hands and directed him to the side room; guest and host both took their seats.

sentences.zh: 冠者衣青衣素裳出戶西，南面立，賓主俱興。

translations.literal: The crown-wearer dressed in green upper garment and plain lower skirt, came out west of the door, stood facing south; guest and host both rose.
translations.idiomatic: The crown-wearer, dressed in a green upper garment and plain lower skirt, came out west of the door and stood facing south; guest and host both rose.

sentences.zh: 賓揖冠者，冠者進升席，西向坐。

translations.literal: The guest bowed with clasped hands to the crown-wearer; the crown-wearer advanced and ascended the seat mat, sitting facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The guest bowed with clasped hands to the crown-wearer, who advanced, ascended the seat mat, and sat facing west.

sentences.zh: 賓贊冠者跪，脫緇布冠，櫛畢，設纚。

translations.literal: The guest's crown announcer knelt, removed the black cloth cap, finished combing, and set the binding cord.
translations.idiomatic: The guest's crown announcer knelt, removed the black cloth cap, finished combing his hair, and set the binding cord.

sentences.zh: 賓進進賢冠，立祝，如初加禮。

translations.literal: The guest advanced with the Scholar-Aspiring Coronet, stood and intoned the prayer, as in the first investiture rite.
translations.idiomatic: The guest advanced with the Scholar-Aspiring Coronet, stood and intoned the prayer, following the procedure of the first investiture.

sentences.zh: 祝畢，跪冠，興，復位。

translations.literal: When the prayer was finished, knelt and capped him, rose, returned to position.
translations.idiomatic: When the prayer was finished, he knelt and placed the cap upon him, rose, and returned to his position.

sentences.zh: 賓贊冠者跪，脫進賢冠，櫛畢，設纚。

translations.literal: The guest's crown announcer knelt, removed the Scholar-Aspiring Coronet, finished combing, and set the binding cord.
translations.idiomatic: The guest's crown announcer knelt, removed the Scholar-Aspiring Coronet, finished combing his hair, and set the binding cord.

sentences.zh: 賓進爵弁，立祝，如再加禮。

translations.literal: The guest advanced with the noble cap, stood and intoned the prayer, as in the second investiture rite.
translations.idiomatic: The guest advanced with the noble cap, stood and intoned the prayer, following the procedure of the second investiture.

sentences.zh: 賓贊冠者，設簪結纓如前。

translations.literal: The guest's crown announcer set the hairpin and tied the cap tassels as before.
translations.idiomatic: The guest's crown announcer set the hairpin and tied the cap tassels, as before.

sentences.zh: 冠者適房，著爵弁之服出。

translations.literal: The crown-wearer went to the side room, put on the noble-cap attire, and came out.
translations.idiomatic: The crown-wearer went to the side room, donned the noble-cap attire, and came out.

sentences.zh: 主贊冠者徹纚櫛及筵，入於房。

translations.literal: The host's crown announcer removed the binding cord, comb, and ceremonial mat, and entered the side room.
translations.idiomatic: The host's crown announcer cleared away the binding cord, comb, and ceremonial mat, and entered the side room.

sentences.zh: 又設筵於室戶西，南向。

translations.literal: A ceremonial mat was again set west of the chamber door, facing south.
translations.idiomatic: Another ceremonial mat was set west of the chamber door, facing south.

sentences.zh: 冠者出房戶西，南面立。

translations.literal: The crown-wearer came out west of the side-room door and stood facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The crown-wearer came out west of the side-room door and stood facing south.

sentences.zh: 主贊洗觶於房，酌醴出，南面立。

translations.literal: The host's crown announcer washed the single-handled cup in the side room, poured the ritual wine, came out, and stood facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The host's crown announcer washed the single-handled cup in the side room, poured the ritual wine, came out, and stood facing south.

sentences.zh: 賓揖冠者就筵西，南面立。

translations.literal: The guest bowed with clasped hands to the crown-wearer to approach west of the ceremonial mat and stand facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The guest bowed with clasped hands, directing the crown-wearer to approach west of the ceremonial mat and stand facing south.

sentences.zh: 賓受醴，進冠者筵前，北面立。

translations.literal: The guest received the ritual wine, advanced to before the crown-wearer's ceremonial mat, and stood facing north.
translations.idiomatic: The guest received the ritual wine, advanced to before the crown-wearer's ceremonial mat, and stood facing north.

sentences.zh: 祝畢，冠者拜受觶，賓復西階上答拜。

translations.literal: When the prayer was finished, the crown-wearer bowed and received the cup; the guest returned atop the western steps and returned the bow.
translations.idiomatic: When the prayer was finished, the crown-wearer bowed and received the cup; the guest returned to the top of the western steps and returned the bow.

sentences.zh: 執饌者進饌於筵，冠者左執觶，右取脯，祭於籩豆間。

translations.literal: The food bearer presented food at the ceremonial mat; the crown-wearer held the cup in his left hand, took cured meat with his right, and made an offering between the basket and stem-cup.
translations.idiomatic: The food bearer presented food at the ceremonial mat; the crown-wearer held the cup in his left hand, took cured meat with his right, and made an offering between the basket and stem-cup.

sentences.zh: 贊者取胏一以授冠者，奠觶於薦西以祭。

translations.literal: The announcer took one piece of meat with bone and handed it to the crown-wearer; he set the cup west of the offering mat to make an offering.
translations.idiomatic: The announcer took one piece of meat with bone and handed it to the crown-wearer, who set the cup west of the offering mat to make an offering.

sentences.zh: 冠者坐取觶，祭醴，奠觶，再拜，賓答拜。

translations.literal: The crown-wearer sat, took the cup, offered the ritual wine, set down the cup, performed two bows; the guest returned the bows.
translations.idiomatic: The crown-wearer sat, took the cup, offered the ritual wine, set down the cup, and performed two bows; the guest returned the bows.

sentences.zh: 冠者執觶興，賓主俱坐。

translations.literal: The crown-wearer rose holding the cup; guest and host both sat.
translations.idiomatic: The crown-wearer rose holding the cup; guest and host both took their seats.

sentences.zh: 冠者升筵，跪奠觶於薦東。

translations.literal: The crown-wearer ascended the ceremonial mat, knelt and set the cup east of the offering mat.
translations.idiomatic: The crown-wearer ascended the ceremonial mat, knelt, and set the cup east of the offering mat.

sentences.zh: 興，進，北面跪取脯，降自西階。

translations.literal: Rose, advanced, knelt facing north and took the cured meat, descended by the western steps.
translations.idiomatic: He rose, advanced, knelt facing north and took the cured meat, then descended the western steps.

sentences.zh: 入見母，進奠脯於席前。

translations.literal: Entered to see his mother, advanced and set the cured meat before her mat.
translations.idiomatic: He entered to see his mother, advanced, and set the cured meat before her mat.

sentences.zh: 退，再拜出。

translations.literal: Withdrew, performed two bows, and went out.
translations.idiomatic: He withdrew, performed two bows, and went out.

sentences.zh: 母不在，則使人受脯於西階下。

translations.literal: If the mother was not present, someone was sent to receive the cured meat below the western steps.
translations.idiomatic: If the mother was not present, someone was sent to receive the cured meat below the western steps.

sentences.zh: 初，冠者入見母，賓主俱興。

translations.literal: Initially, when the crown-wearer entered to see his mother, guest and host both rose.
translations.idiomatic: At the outset, when the crown-wearer entered to see his mother, guest and host both rose.

sentences.zh: 賓降，當西序東面立，主者降，當東序西面立。

translations.literal: The guest descended and stood at the western wing facing east; the host descended and stood at the eastern wing facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The guest descended and stood at the western wing facing east; the host descended and stood at the eastern wing facing west.

sentences.zh: 冠者出，立於西階東，南面。

translations.literal: The crown-wearer came out and stood east of the western steps facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The crown-wearer came out and stood east of the western steps, facing south.

sentences.zh: 賓少進字之，辭同士禮。

translations.literal: The guest advanced slightly and bestowed the style name; the wording was the same as in the scholar's rite.
translations.idiomatic: The guest advanced slightly and bestowed the style name, using the same wording as in the scholar's rite.

sentences.zh: 冠者再拜，跪曰：「某不敏，夙夜祗承。

translations.literal: The crown-wearer performed two bows, knelt and said: "I, So-and-so, am not worthy; day and night I reverently accept.
translations.idiomatic: The crown-wearer performed two bows, knelt, and said: "I, So-and-so, am unworthy; day and night I shall reverently uphold this charge.

sentences.zh: 」賓出，主者送於內門外，西向，請禮從者。

translations.literal: " The guest went out; the host escorted him outside the inner gate, faced west, and invited courtesy for his attendants.
translations.idiomatic: The guest departed; the host escorted him outside the inner gate, faced west, and invited courtesy for his attendants.

sentences.zh: 賓就次，主者入。

translations.literal: The guest went to his tent; the host entered.
translations.idiomatic: The guest went to his tent; the host entered.

sentences.zh: 初，賓出，冠者東面見諸親，諸親拜之，冠者答拜。

translations.literal: Initially, when the guest went out, the crown-wearer faced east to see his relatives; the relatives bowed to him, and the crown-wearer returned the bows.
translations.idiomatic: At the outset, when the guest departed, the crown-wearer faced east to greet his relatives; the relatives bowed to him, and he returned the bows.

sentences.zh: 冠者西向拜賓贊，賓贊亦答拜。

translations.literal: The crown-wearer faced west and bowed to the guest's crown announcer; the guest's crown announcer also returned the bow.
translations.idiomatic: The crown-wearer faced west and bowed to the guest's crown announcer, who returned the bow.

sentences.zh: 見諸尊於別室，亦如之。

translations.literal: He saw the honorees in the separate room; likewise.
translations.idiomatic: He received the honorees in the separate room in the same manner.

sentences.zh: 賓主既釋服，入醴席，一獻訖，賓與衆賓出次，立於門東，西面。

translations.literal: After guest and host had changed out of ceremonial dress, they entered the ritual-wine mat; one round of offering finished, the guest and attendant guests went out to the tent and stood east of the gate facing west.
translations.idiomatic: After guest and host had changed out of ceremonial dress, they entered the ritual-wine mat; when one round of offering was complete, the guest and attendant guests went out to the tent and stood east of the gate, facing west.

sentences.zh: 主者出揖賓，賓報揖。

translations.literal: The host went out and bowed with clasped hands to the guest; the guest returned the bow.
translations.idiomatic: The host went out and bowed with clasped hands to the guest, who returned the bow.

sentences.zh: 主者先入，賓及衆賓從之。

translations.literal: The host entered first; the guest and attendant guests followed.
translations.idiomatic: The host entered first; the guest and attendant guests followed.

sentences.zh: 至階，賓立於西階上，主者立於東階上，衆賓立於西階下。

translations.literal: Reaching the steps, the guest stood atop the western steps, the host atop the eastern steps, and the attendant guests below the western steps.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching the steps, the guest stood atop the western steps, the host atop the eastern steps, and the attendant guests below the western steps.

sentences.zh: 主者授幣篚於賓贊，復位，還阼階上，北面拜送。

translations.literal: The host handed the basket of gifts to the guest's crown announcer, returned to position, went back atop the eastern steps, and bowed facing north in farewell.
translations.idiomatic: The host handed the basket of gifts to the guest's crown announcer, returned to his position, went back atop the eastern steps, and bowed facing north in farewell.

sentences.zh: 賓贊降自西階，主者送賓於大門外，西面，再拜而入。

translations.literal: The guest's crown announcer descended by the western steps; the host escorted the guest outside the great gate, faced west, performed two bows, and entered.
translations.idiomatic: The guest's crown announcer descended the western steps; the host escorted the guest outside the main gate, faced west, performed two bows, and reentered.

sentences.zh: 孤子則諸父諸兄戒賓。

translations.literal: For an orphan, paternal uncles and elder brothers notified the guest.
translations.idiomatic: For an orphan, paternal uncles and elder brothers notified the guest in the host's stead.

sentences.zh: 冠之日，主者紒而迎賓，冠於阼階下，其儀亦如之。

translations.literal: On the day of capping, the host with hair bound received the guest; capping took place below the eastern steps; the procedure was likewise.
translations.idiomatic: On the day of capping, the host with bound hair received the guest; the capping took place below the eastern steps, and the procedure was the same.

sentences.zh: 明日見廟，冠者朝服入南門中庭道西，北面再拜出。

translations.literal: The next day he visited the temple: the crown-wearer in court dress entered the southern gate, west of the central courtyard path, faced north, performed two bows, and went out.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he visited the ancestral temple: the crown-wearer, in court dress, entered the southern gate to the west of the central courtyard path, faced north, performed two bows, and departed.

sentences.zh: 庶人冠禮

translations.literal: Capping Rite for Commoners
translations.idiomatic: The Capping Rite for Commoners

sentences.zh: 古冠禮之存者惟士禮，後世皆推而用之。

translations.literal: Of ancient capping rites, only the scholar's rite survives; later ages all extended and applied it.
translations.idiomatic: Of the ancient capping rites, only the scholar's rite survives; later ages all extended and applied it.

sentences.zh: 明洪武元年詔定冠禮，下及庶人，纖悉備具。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongwu of Ming an edict fixed the capping rite, extending down to commoners, with every detail fully provided.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Hongwu, the Ming court issued an edict fixing the capping rite, extending it down to commoners, with every detail fully specified.

sentences.zh: 然自品官而降，鮮有能行之者，載之禮官，備故事而已。

translations.literal: Yet from ranked officials downward, few could actually perform it; it was recorded in the rite offices, serving merely as precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Yet from ranked officials downward, few could actually perform it; it was recorded in the rite offices and served merely as precedent.

sentences.zh: 凡男子年十五至二十，皆可冠。

translations.literal: Any man from fifteen to twenty years of age could undergo capping.
translations.idiomatic: Any man between the ages of fifteen and twenty could undergo the capping ceremony.

sentences.zh: 將冠，筮日，筮賓，戒賓，俱如品官儀。

translations.literal: When about to cap, divining the day, divining the guest, and notifying the guest—all followed the ranked-official rite.
translations.idiomatic: When about to cap, divining the day, divining the guest, and notifying the guest—all followed the procedure for ranked officials.

sentences.zh: 是日，夙興，張幄爲房於廳事東，皆盛服。

translations.literal: On that day, rising early, a canopy was hung as a side room east of the hall; all wore full dress.
translations.idiomatic: On that day, rising early, a canopy was hung as a side room east of the reception hall; all wore full ceremonial dress.

sentences.zh: 設盥於阼階下東南，陳服於房中西牖下。

translations.literal: Hand-washing was set southeast below the eastern steps; garments were displayed below the western window of the side room.
translations.idiomatic: Hand-washing vessels were set southeast below the eastern steps; garments were laid out below the western window of the side room.

sentences.zh: 席二在南，酒在服北次。

translations.literal: Two mats to the south; wine next north of the garments.
translations.idiomatic: Two mats were placed to the south; wine was set next, north of the garments.

sentences.zh: 襆頭巾帽，各盛以盤，三人捧之，立於堂下西階之西，南向東上。

translations.literal: Futou, kerchief, and cap—each placed on a tray, three men holding them, standing west of the western steps below the hall, facing south from east to north.
translations.idiomatic: The futou, kerchief, and cap—each placed on a tray and held by one of three attendants—stood west of the western steps below the hall, facing south from east to north.

sentences.zh: 主人立於阼階下，諸親立於盥東，儐者立於門外以俟賓。

translations.literal: The host stood below the eastern steps; relatives stood east of the hand-washing place; the usher stood outside the gate awaiting the guest.
translations.idiomatic: The host stood below the eastern steps; relatives stood east of the hand-washing place; the usher stood outside the gate awaiting the guest.

sentences.zh: 冠者雙紒袍，勒帛素履待於房。

translations.literal: The crown-wearer with double bound hair and robe, girded with a plain sash and plain shoes, waited in the side room.
translations.idiomatic: The crown-wearer, with hair bound in double coils and wearing a robe girded with a plain sash and plain shoes, waited in the side room.

sentences.zh: 賓至，主人出迎，揖而入。

translations.literal: When the guest arrived, the host went out to receive him, bowed with clasped hands, and entered.
translations.idiomatic: When the guest arrived, the host went out to receive him, bowed with clasped hands, and entered together.

sentences.zh: 坐定，冠者出於房，執事者請行事。

translations.literal: When seated, the crown-wearer came out from the side room; the functionary requested that the rite proceed.
translations.idiomatic: When all were seated, the crown-wearer came out from the side room, and the functionary requested that the rite proceed.

sentences.zh: 賓之贊者取櫛總篦幧頭，置於席南端。

translations.literal: The guest's announcer took the comb, hair-binding, hairpin, and headcloth, and placed them at the south end of the seat mat.
translations.idiomatic: The guest's announcer took the comb, hair-binding, hairpin, and headcloth, and placed them at the south end of the seat mat.

sentences.zh: 賓揖冠者，即席西向坐。

translations.literal: The guest bowed with clasped hands to the crown-wearer, who immediately took the seat mat facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The guest bowed with clasped hands to the crown-wearer, who immediately took the seat mat and sat facing west.

sentences.zh: 贊者爲之櫛，合紒施總，加幧頭。

translations.literal: The announcer combed his hair for him, gathered and bound the hair, applied the hair-binding, and placed on the headcloth.
translations.idiomatic: The announcer combed his hair, gathered and bound it, applied the hair-binding, and placed the headcloth upon him.

sentences.zh: 賓降，主亦降，立於阼階下。

translations.literal: The guest descended; the host also descended; they stood below the eastern steps.
translations.idiomatic: The guest descended; the host also descended; both stood below the eastern steps.

sentences.zh: 賓盥，主人揖讓，升自西階，復位。

translations.literal: The guest washed; the host bowed with clasped hands in deference; the guest ascended by the western steps and returned to position.
translations.idiomatic: The guest washed; the host bowed with clasped hands in deference; the guest ascended the western steps and returned to his position.

sentences.zh: 執事者進巾，賓降一等受之，詣冠者席前，東向。

translations.literal: The functionary presented the kerchief; the guest descended one step and received it, went before the crown-wearer's seat mat facing east.
translations.idiomatic: The functionary presented the kerchief; the guest descended one step to receive it, then went before the crown-wearer's seat mat facing east.

sentences.zh: 祝詞同品官。

translations.literal: The prayer wording was the same as for ranked officials.
translations.idiomatic: The prayer wording was the same as for ranked officials.

sentences.zh: 祝訖，跪著巾。

translations.literal: When the prayer was finished, knelt and placed the kerchief on him.
translations.idiomatic: When the prayer was finished, he knelt and placed the kerchief upon him.

sentences.zh: 興，復位。

translations.literal: Rose, returned to position.
translations.idiomatic: He rose and returned to his position.

sentences.zh: 冠者興，賓揖之入房，易服，深衣大帶，出就冠席。

translations.literal: The crown-wearer rose; the guest bowed with clasped hands and directed him into the side room; he changed garments into deep robe and great sash, came out and approached the capping seat.
translations.idiomatic: The crown-wearer rose; the guest bowed with clasped hands and directed him into the side room; he changed into a deep robe and great sash, came out, and approached the capping seat.

sentences.zh: 賓盥如初。

translations.literal: The guest washed as at first.
translations.idiomatic: The guest washed as before.

sentences.zh: 執事者進帽，賓降二等受之。

translations.literal: The functionary presented the cap; the guest descended two steps and received it.
translations.idiomatic: The functionary presented the cap; the guest descended two steps to receive it.

sentences.zh: 進祝，跪，冠訖，興，復位。

translations.literal: Advanced, intoned the prayer, knelt, finished capping, rose, returned to position.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced, intoned the prayer, knelt, completed the capping, rose, and returned to his position.

sentences.zh: 揖冠者入房，易服，襴衫要帶，出就冠席。

translations.literal: Bowed with clasped hands to the crown-wearer to enter the side room; changed garments into round-collared robe with sash, came out and approached the capping seat.
translations.idiomatic: He bowed with clasped hands, directing the crown-wearer into the side room; the crown-wearer changed into a round-collared robe with sash, came out, and approached the capping seat.

sentences.zh: 賓盥如初。

translations.literal: The guest washed as at first.
translations.idiomatic: The guest washed as before.

sentences.zh: 執事者進襆頭，賓降三等受之。

translations.literal: The functionary presented the futou; the guest descended three steps and received it.
translations.idiomatic: The functionary presented the futou; the guest descended three steps to receive it.

sentences.zh: 進祝，跪，冠訖，興，復位。

translations.literal: Advanced, intoned the prayer, knelt, finished capping, rose, returned to position.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced, intoned the prayer, knelt, completed the capping, rose, and returned to his position.

sentences.zh: 揖冠者入房，易公服出。

translations.literal: Bowed with clasped hands to the crown-wearer to enter the side room; changed into formal dress and came out.
translations.idiomatic: He bowed with clasped hands, directing the crown-wearer into the side room; the crown-wearer changed into formal dress and came out.

sentences.zh: 執事者徹冠席，設醴席於西階，南向。

translations.literal: The functionary cleared the capping seat and set the ritual-wine mat on the western steps facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The functionary cleared the capping seat and set the ritual-wine mat on the western steps, facing south.

sentences.zh: 贊者酌醴出房，立於冠者之南。

translations.literal: The announcer poured the ritual wine, came out from the side room, and stood south of the crown-wearer.
translations.idiomatic: The announcer poured the ritual wine, came out from the side room, and stood south of the crown-wearer.

sentences.zh: 賓揖冠者即席，西向立。

translations.literal: The guest bowed with clasped hands to the crown-wearer to approach the seat facing west and stand.
translations.idiomatic: The guest bowed with clasped hands, directing the crown-wearer to approach the seat and stand facing west.

sentences.zh: 賓受醴，詣席前北面祝。

translations.literal: The guest received the ritual wine, went before the mat facing north and intoned the prayer.
translations.idiomatic: The guest received the ritual wine, went before the mat facing north, and intoned the prayer.

sentences.zh: 冠者拜受，賓答拜。

translations.literal: The crown-wearer bowed and received it; the guest returned the bow.
translations.idiomatic: The crown-wearer bowed and received it; the guest returned the bow.

sentences.zh: 執事者進饌，冠者即席坐，飲食訖，再拜。

translations.literal: The functionary presented food; the crown-wearer took the seat and sat, finished eating and drinking, performed two bows.
translations.idiomatic: The functionary presented food; the crown-wearer took his seat, finished eating and drinking, and performed two bows.

sentences.zh: 賓答拜。

translations.literal: The guest returned the bows.
translations.idiomatic: The guest returned the bows.

sentences.zh: 冠者離席，立於西階之東，南向。

translations.literal: The crown-wearer left the seat and stood east of the western steps facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The crown-wearer left his seat and stood east of the western steps, facing south.

sentences.zh: 賓字之，如品官詞。

translations.literal: The guest bestowed the style name, using the wording for ranked officials.
translations.idiomatic: The guest bestowed the style name, using the wording prescribed for ranked officials.

sentences.zh: 冠者拜，賓答拜。

translations.literal: The crown-wearer bowed; the guest returned the bow.
translations.idiomatic: The crown-wearer bowed; the guest returned the bow.

sentences.zh: 冠者拜父母，父母爲之起。

translations.literal: The crown-wearer bowed to his parents; his parents rose for him.
translations.idiomatic: The crown-wearer bowed to his parents; his parents rose in acknowledgment.

sentences.zh: 拜諸父之尊者，遂出見鄉先生及父之執友。

translations.literal: He bowed to the senior paternal uncles, then went out to see the village elder and his father's close friends.
translations.idiomatic: He bowed to the senior paternal uncles, then went out to pay his respects to the village elder and his father's close friends.

sentences.zh: 先生執友皆答拜。

translations.literal: The teacher and the father's friends all returned the prostrations.
translations.idiomatic: The teacher and the father's friends all returned the bows in reply.

sentences.zh: 賓退，主人請禮賓，固請，乃入，設酒饌。

translations.literal: The guest withdrew; the host invited the ritual guest to be entertained; after repeated urging, he entered, and wine and food were set out.
translations.idiomatic: When the guest withdrew, the host invited the ritual officiant to stay for a meal; after repeated urging the officiant entered, and wine and food were set out.

sentences.zh: 賓退，主人酬賓贊，侑以幣。

translations.literal: The guest withdrew; the host rewarded the guest's announcer, presenting silks as an auxiliary gift.
translations.idiomatic: When the guest withdrew, the host rewarded the guest's announcer with silks as a supplementary gift.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，主人以冠者見於祠堂，再拜出。

translations.literal: When the rite was complete, the host presented the newly capped youth at the ancestral shrine; he performed two prostrations and departed.
translations.idiomatic: When the ceremony was finished, the host presented the newly capped youth at the ancestral shrine; the youth performed two prostrations and withdrew.
